startup.name: ProxyKeywords Studio

startup.descriptionShort: Extract search volume, KD, and keyword ideas across 150+ countries without getting blocked by anti-bot systems.
startup.descriptionLong: ProxyKeywords Studio is an intelligent SEO intelligence and keyword automation engine. By utilizing a stealth browser pipeline with persistent context and anti-bot cloaking, it enables marketing agencies and developers to conduct deep competitive research across Google, Ahrefs, and search platforms in bulk, streaming real-time metrics into consolidated reports.
